description: This file defines a Swift enum `StatusActivityBuilder` with a static method `build` that creates and returns a `StatusPill.Activity` object based on various conditions related to the application model, camera HUD, voice wake status, and other states. It encapsulates logic for determining the current status indicator to display in the UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a `StatusPill.Activity` based on application, camera, and voice wake status parameters.
